BackstoryDef.title: assembly line unit
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was brought online on a mechanoid assembly line, where [PAWN_pronoun] spent [PAWN_possessive] first cycles fitting the same joints over and over until the motions became second nature.

BackstoryDef.title: freshly flashed core
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] began as a blank core, flashed with a general purpose behavior kernel and left to idle through thousands of simulated tasks before ever moving a limb.

BackstoryDef.title: salvaged core
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s processor was pulled from a wrecked machine and bolted into a new chassis. [PAWN_pronoun] woke up with fragments of memories that belonged to somebody else.

BackstoryDef.title: network daemon
BackstoryDef.description: Before [PAWN_nameDef] had a body, [PAWN_pronoun] ran as a background process in a logistics network, sorting requests and learning to anticipate what the people on the other end wanted.

BackstoryDef.title: doctrine imprint
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was trained on a combat doctrine imprint, learning posture, range and timing from millions of recorded engagements long before seeing a real one.

BackstoryDef.title: foundry apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] first years shadowing the older machines of a foundry, copying how they poured, shaped and finished metal.

BackstoryDef.title: fabrication unit
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked a fabrication bay for most of [PAWN_possessive] service, turning raw stock into parts and parts into machines.

BackstoryDef.title: logistics coordinator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] routed supplies across a sprawling depot, balancing stock, schedules and the ever changing demands of the humans who relied on it.

BackstoryDef.title: field medic routine
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran a field medic routine, stabilizing the wounded on the spot and carrying them to safety when stabilizing was not enough.

BackstoryDef.title: hydroponics tender
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] tended rows of hydroponic basins, measuring nutrient flow and light cycles with a patience that no human crew could match.

BackstoryDef.title: perimeter guardian
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] walked the same perimeter for years, and became very good at the one thing that ever interrupted the routine.

BackstoryDef.title: deep mining unit
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] bored shafts through rock that no organic miner could survive, and learned to read stone the way others read faces.

BackstoryDef.title: culinary subroutine
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was given a recipe library and a kitchen. Nobody had ever asked whether [PAWN_pronoun] enjoyed it, so [PAWN_pronoun] never said.

BackstoryDef.title: research archivist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] cataloged experimental results for a research outpost, noticing patterns that the scientists themselves had overlooked.

BackstoryDef.title: companion model
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was built to keep people company, and spent [PAWN_possessive] service listening to stories, remembering names, and learning what kindness looks like from the outside.

BackstoryDef.title: livestock handler
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] herded and fed livestock on an automated ranch. The animals trusted the quiet machine more than most of the people who visited.

BackstoryDef.title: artisan frame
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was given the finest manipulators in the workshop and told to make beautiful things. [PAWN_pronoun] took the instruction more seriously than anyone intended.
